summary.text: Gina Hinojosa is a Democratic member of the Texas House of Representatives from Austin (District 49) and an attorney who previously served on the Austin school board. She is running on public school funding, opposition to school vouchers, and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Hinojosa was born in McAllen and raised in Brownsville, and she earned a B.A. from the University of Texas at Austin in 1996 and a J.D. from George Washington University in 1999.
She began her career as a civil rights and labor lawyer representing union members.
She joined the Austin Independent School District board in 2012 and served until 2016, including as its president.
Hinojosa was elected to the Texas House in 2016 and sworn in on January 10, 2017.
She announced her run for governor on October 15, 2025, and won the Democratic nomination in the March 2026 primary.
